data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰海浮台的夏日魔法
data.description: 艾尔菲利亚穿着冰蓝泳装坐在漂浮木台，脚边的海水凝成细小冰花；她一手举着冰镇果汁，一手让一只小冰鸟停在指尖，蓝瞳因为成功的魔法而闪亮。
data.location: floating platform on a magical ice sea
data.action: 冰海浮台上让海水绽成冰花，举果汁展示停在指尖的小冰鸟
data.lighting: bright afternoon light through crystalline spray
data.promptProse: Seated on the floating platform, she holds chilled juice in one hand and balances a tiny ice bird on the opposite fingertip. Afternoon sun catches the bird's clear wings above the bright water.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the juice while a tiny ice bird balances on the opposite fingertip.
